title: POV:

A billionaire put a dome
over the city.
subs: In 2030, a billionaire put a glass dome over the city.
In twenty thirty, a billionaire put a glass dome over the city.
To control the weather.
It was always 22 degrees.
It was always twenty-two degrees.
It never rained.
Then sunsets became a premium feature.
Free users get the sun switched off at 8 p.m.
Free users get the sun switched off at eight p.m.
Like a light.
Snow is available on weekends. For a fee.
Then the city next door got jealous.
They built a bigger dome. Over our dome.
Now we get their weather.
It has been raining for six months.
Inside both domes.
Then a third city built a dome over all of us.
Nobody has seen the real sky since.
Scientists believe it's still up there.
Somewhere.
